title: WindBorne raises $37 million to expand balloon-fed AI weather forecasts
friendlyTitle: AI weather company WindBorne raises $37 million
summary: WindBorne Systems raised a $37 million Series B to expand its long-duration weather-balloon network, forecasting models and commercial team. It operates about 600 balloons and combines their measurements with public weather data to produce forecasts for government and business customers.
friendlySummary: WindBorne uses hundreds of long-flying balloons to collect weather data and feed AI forecasts. New funding will help it grow the network and sell forecasts to more organisations.
whyItMatters: AI weather models become more valuable when paired with measurements from places traditional systems undersample. Better local forecasts can improve decisions in logistics, energy, agriculture, insurance and disaster preparation rather than merely produce a more impressive weather app.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Better forecasts can help people plan transport, farming, energy use and emergency work.
